{/* Hero Section */}

❤️ Hello, Love!

This is my quiet little corner of the world made just for you. Scroll with me.

{/* Section 1 */}

🌱 What You Healed In Me

I was doubting myself — unsure, insecure. You didn’t try to fix me. You just stayed. That healed more than you’ll ever know.

{/* Section 2 */}

🌸 Your Softness

You speak gently. You care for your family even when your body is tired. That’s not weakness. That’s softness — and it’s strong.

{/* Section 3 */}

🫂 You Make Me Feel Safe

I never felt like I had to perform. With you, I don’t need to impress — I just need to be. That’s what love is supposed to feel like.

{/* Section 4 */}

🎶 Your Voice

It’s not just beautiful — it’s comforting. Even when you're timid, your presence is loud with care.

{/* Section 5 */}

💌 Thank You

For talking to me even when you’re exhausted. For showing up. For existing. I see you, and I cherish you.

{/* Ending */}

That’s All. But Not Really.

There are a thousand little things I didn’t say here. But I hope this is a small reflection of how I see you.

❤️
